purpose: Controlled laboratory internal pump leakage, not field validation
label: profile.txt column 3: 0=no leakage, 1=weak, 2=severe
testReuse: Same final 441 cycles as the published historical CatBoost benchmark; not a new blind holdout. No selection or parameter changes using this test.

features.scope: Within-cycle sensor features only. No other profile labels, stable flag, cycle index, neighboring cycles or virtual efficiency channels.

stressProtocol.scope: Independent feature-space sensitivity perturbations on the real test rows; not a physical sensor simulator, not independent validation, not new fault ground truth.

selection: AutoGluon uses validation log_loss only; four arms registered before fit. CatBoost early stopping=40, AutoGluon native early stopping.
memoryScope: Whole-process cumulative peak RSS, including feature extraction and all arms; not isolated model memory.

serializationVerification.scope: Reload saved trusted artifacts and reproduce existing test metrics, without refitting or tuning.

bestArmScope: Validation ranking of the four fixed experiments; no model is approved for production.
